Our partnership

Because care
should reach
further.

Esselunga and Médecins Sans Frontières have come together around a simple belief: everyday connections can help make care possible. A familiar place in your neighbourhood becomes a way to stand alongside people facing illness, emergencies, and uncertainty.

Through a three-year commitment, Esselunga supports MSF’s independent medical work, providing a steady foundation beyond a single campaign. Customers can add their own gesture of generosity through a receipt, at a time and with an amount that feels right for them.

The partnership also brings care closer to Esselunga’s teams. Crisis-awareness sessions create space to recognise emotional distress, understand its effects, and learn where to turn for support after difficult events.

Three years.

A lasting commitment, giving care room to continue.

A small gesture, entirely yours

Your usual shop.
A new way to give.

No extra steps at the checkout. Take your receipt home, find a quiet moment, and decide whether you would like to give. Every contribution is a choice, and every amount is welcome.

01 /

Shop as you normally do.

Look for the partnership message on your receipt at participating Esselunga stores. Keep it with you: the QR code is an invitation you can return to later, without holding up your shopping or making a decision at the till.

02 /

A moment for someone else.

Scan the receipt’s QR code with your phone to visit the MSF donation page. Choose a one-off amount, review the details, and select your payment method. A final confirmation lets you know you have reached the end of the journey.

03 /

Let kindness go further.

Esselunga matches eligible customer donations while its annual €50,000 matching fund is available, alongside its own corporate contribution. Your gesture adds to a shared commitment to support independent medical care.

Find your way to take part ↗
A few helpful answers

Good to
know.

How do I make a donation?

At a participating store, scan the QR code on your receipt to open the MSF donation page. You choose the amount and complete your donation there. This project website does not collect payments.

Do I have to donate when I shop?

No. Giving is entirely voluntary. You can take your receipt home and decide later, or simply continue with your day.

How does Esselunga contribute?

The partnership includes an annual corporate contribution of €250,000 for three years. Esselunga also matches customer donations up to a total of €50,000 per year. Its annual contribution stands independently of customer participation.

What does my donation support?

Donations support MSF’s independent humanitarian medical work. This campaign does not attach a specific treatment, patient outcome, or location to an individual donation.

What does the partnership mean for employees?

Crisis-awareness sessions help managers and colleagues recognise emotional distress after events such as floods, and learn about routes to support. Clinical counselling remains with qualified wellbeing providers.

Where can I take part?

Look for the partnership message on receipts at participating stores during the initial pilot. Your receipt will guide you to the donation page.
